directory.title: Our members
directory.intro: Seventeen local businesses who know, trust and refer each other. Find the right person for what you need.
directory.empty: No members in this category yet.
directory.joinCta: Run a local business? Join the Club

privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language
privacy.p1: When a member refers you to another member, we store only your first name, one way to reach you (phone or email), and a short note about what you need.
privacy.p2: A member can only send a referral after you have agreed to be introduced. Only the member who sent it, the member who received it, and the two club admins can see it.
privacy.p3: We never ask for or store ID numbers, immigration status, financial details or other sensitive information.
privacy.p4: Want your information removed? Ask the member who referred you, or contact the club. An admin will delete it.
privacy.p5: This site uses no tracking or advertising cookies. Data is stored with Supabase, our database provider.

login.title: Member login
login.intro: Enter the email address the club has on file for you. We'll email you a login link and a 6-digit code. No password needed.
login.sent: Check your inbox. Tap the link, or type the 6-digit code below if the link opens in another browser.
login.invalid: That code didn't work. It may have expired, so send a new one.
login.notMemberTitle: This email isn't linked to a member
login.notMemberBody: You're signed in as {email}, but it isn't on the members list. Ask a club admin to add it, or log out and try the email the club has on file.

dashboard.title: Hello, {name}
dashboard.generated: Your referrals helped other members close {value} of business.
dashboard.thanksBody: Your referral to {name} closed. Thank you from the Club!
dashboard.pendingCount: You have {n} referral(s) waiting for a reply.

send.title: Send a referral
send.intro: Introduce a client to another member. They get an email and can accept or decline.
send.needHint: One or two lines, for example: "First-time buyer, looking for a 2-bed condo in Lonsdale."
send.notesHint: Best time to call, language preference, and so on.
send.privacyHint: Only first name, one contact and a short need. Don't include ID numbers, immigration status or financial details.
send.consent: The client agreed to be introduced to this member and for the club to store these details.
send.success: Referral sent to {name}. They've been notified.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: This is what visitors see in the public directory.
profile.logoHint: Link to a square image. Leave blank to show your initials.

join.title: Join the Club
join.intro: VancoBiz Club is a small network of trusted North Vancouver businesses. Tell us about yours and an admin will be in touch.
join.reason: Why do you want to join?
join.success: Thank you! Your request has been sent to the club admins.

admin.headline: This month the club passed {value} of business between members.
admin.csvHint: The export leaves out client names and contact details.
admin.redactConfirm: Remove this client's name, contact, need and notes? The referral stays in the stats. This can't be undone.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete this referral completely, including it from the stats? This can't be undone.
admin.loginEmailHint: The email this member uses to log in. Not shown publicly.

voice.title: Tell us about your business
voice.intro: Talk to the club assistant for about 15 minutes, in Farsi or English. It asks about your services, prices and the questions clients ask you, then writes a draft profile for you to check.
voice.agentHint: Printed by "npm run voice:create-agents". Saved in this browser only.
voice.consent1: Your voice is sent to ElevenLabs and what you say is processed by Anthropic's Claude. Both are US companies.
voice.consent2: Talk about your business only. Do not say any client's name, phone number, file or health details.
voice.consent3: This test page stores nothing. The draft stays on your screen until you download it.
voice.consentCheck: I understand and agree to this test recording.
voice.micDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access for this site and try again.
voice.draftNote: Written by the assistant from this conversation. Check every line; nothing is saved until you download it.

field.faqs: Questions clients ask, and your answers
field.one_thing: The one thing the tool should do well

survey.title: Five quick questions
survey.intro: We want to build something that saves you time with your clients. Tell us where your week really goes, and we will build around that.

q.time_sink: What task eats most of your time each week?
q.repeat_questions: What do clients ask you over and over?
q.lost_client: Think of the last client you lost. What happened?
q.ai_tools: Which AI tools do you use today?
q.ai_use: What do you use them for?
q.one_wish: If one thing in your business ran itself, what would you choose?

hint.time_sink: For example: answering messages, writing quotes, booking, chasing payments.
hint.repeat_questions: Prices, hours, "do you do X?" Write two or three.
hint.lost_client: A slow reply, price, no follow-up? No client names please.
hint.one_wish: Dream a little. One sentence is enough.

survey.okToChat: Amin or Salar may call me for a 15-minute chat about my answers.
survey.privacy: Only Amin and Salar read your answers. Please do not write any client names or phone numbers. Answers are stored with Supabase, our database provider.
survey.thanksBody: Your answers reached the club. We will share what we learn at the next meeting.
survey.previewNote: Preview only: answers are not saved until the club database is connected.
survey.previewDone: This was a preview, so nothing was saved. Once the club database is connected, answers will reach the admins.
